aka.en: Wushe branch of the Central Cross-Island Highway

tagline.en: From Wushe past Qingjing over the Wuling pass, at 3,275 m the highest point on any road in Taiwan, down to the Central Cross-Island Highway at Dayuling
tagline.zh: 自雾社经清境，翻越海拔 3,275 米、全台公路最高点的武岭，下至大禹岭接中横公路

start.en: Wushe, Ren'ai, Nantou, at 1,148 m, where it leaves Provincial Highway 14
start.zh: 南投县仁爱乡雾社，海拔 1,148 米，自台 14 线分出

end.en: Dayuling, Xiulin, Hualien, at 2,565 m, on Provincial Highway 8
end.zh: 花莲县秀林乡大禹岭，海拔 2,565 米，衔接台 8 线

en: Provincial Highway 14A climbs 41.733 km from Wushe through Qingjing, Cuifeng, Yuanfeng and Kunyang to the Wuling pass on the shoulder of Hehuanshan, then drops to Dayuling on the Central Cross-Island Highway. English Wikipedia gives 41.533 km. Wuling, at 3,275 m at about 31.5 km, is the highest point on a road in Taiwan, and this is the only road in the provincial system above 3,000 m.

The upper half, around Hehuanshan, has standing rules for snow and ice each winter. The lower half serves the Qingjing farm, which began as a Japanese grazing station, was settled by retired servicemen from 1961 and was given its present name in 1965.
zh: 台 14 甲线自雾社起，经清境、翠峰、鸢峰、昆阳，爬升至合欢山肩的武岭，再下至中横公路上的大禹岭，全长 41.733 公里（英文维基百科作 41.533 公里）。武岭位于约 31.5 公里处，海拔 3,275 米，是台湾公路的最高点；这也是省道系统中唯一超过海拔 3,000 米的公路。
上半段在合欢山一带，每年冬季都有固定的降雪、结冰管制规则。下半段服务清境农场；农场前身为日治时期的见晴牧场，1961 年起安置退除役官兵，1965 年改名清境。

en: The pass carried a Japanese name first. In 1914 the governor-general's army crossed it in the Truku campaign, and it became the Sakuma saddle after him. A Japanese road over it, the Hehuan crossing road, was finished in 1935. After the war the pass was called Yinling and then Nanling, measured at the time at 3,284 m, before being renamed Wuling at Chiang Kai-shek's direction.

The present road was built as the Wushe supply line for the Central Cross-Island Highway, roughly along the Japanese road. Sources differ on when it started: Chinese Wikipedia gives 9 June 1957 and the directorate's Fourth District anniversary book 21 January 1957. It opened on 7 May 1958 at 42.2 km. The Kunyang–Hehuan saddle section was cut with machinery by army infantry and production units, and the Jieshou pavilion was put up at the pass in 1958.

In the 1978 renumbering the branch took the number 14A, running from the Wushe junction with Highway 14 to Dayuling. After the earthquake of 21 September 1999 closed the Guguan–Deji section of Highway 8, it became the substitute route across the central range from the west.
zh: 这个垭口先有日本名字。1914 年太鲁阁战役中，台湾总督佐久间左马太率军经此，垭口因而称为佐久间鞍部。日方修筑的合欢越道路于 1935 年完成。战后垭口先后称为银岭、南岭，当时测得海拔 3,284 米，后奉蒋介石之命改名武岭。
今日的公路是作为中横公路的雾社供应线兴建的，大致沿日治道路而行。动工日期说法不一：中文维基百科记为 1957 年 6 月 9 日，公路总局第四区养护工程处周年纪念专刊记为 1957 年 1 月 21 日。1958 年 5 月 7 日通车，长 42.2 公里。昆阳至合欢鞍部一段由陆军步兵与生产部队以机械开凿；同年在垭口建介寿亭。
1978 年省道改编时，这条支线编为台 14 甲线，自雾社与台 14 线交会处起至大禹岭。1999 年 9 月 21 日地震使台 8 线谷关至德基段中断后，这条路成为由西侧翻越中央山脉的替代道路。

en: Snow controls are routine. In a cold spell the Highway Bureau closes the road from 18 km at Cuifeng to 41.5 km at Dayuling from 17:00, letting vehicles out but not in, and may close Wuling to the Songxue Lodge at 32.7 km altogether. Under its 2026 snow-season announcement, when there is snow or ice, coaches, lorries over 3.5 tonnes and all motorcycles, heavy ones included, are barred. Chains are fitted at set points: 18 km, Yuanfeng, Kunyang, Wuling, Xiaofengkou at 36.5 km and Dayuling.

Ordinary works are small. In 2023 the directorate's Second District office let a contract of about NT$32.78 million to improve the surface from 0 to 18 km. An environmental impact statement for widening the 23.552 km from Cuifeng to Dayuling was filed in 1999; what became of it was not found.
zh: 降雪管制已成常态。寒流期间，公路局自 17 时起封闭 18 公里翠峰至 41.5 公里大禹岭，只出不进，必要时并双向封闭武岭至 32.7 公里松雪楼路段。依 2026 年合欢山雪季公告，遇降雪或结冰时，甲、乙类大客车、3.5 吨以上货车及所有机车（含重型机车）一律禁行。雪链在固定地点加装：18 公里、鸢峰、昆阳、武岭、36.5 公里小风口及大禹岭。
一般工程规模不大。2023 年，公路总局第二区养护工程处以约 3,277.86 万元发包 0 至 18 公里道路品质改善工程。1999 年曾提出“台十四甲线翠峰至大禹岭拓宽改善计划”环境影响说明书，长 23.552 公里，其后结果未查到。

en: Speed limits are 25 to 40 km/h. The road above Cuifeng is narrow and steep, with traffic cameras at Kunyang, Wuling, the visitor centre at 32.9 km and Xiaofengkou. The Taiwan KOM Challenge, a cycle race from the Hualien coast up Highway 8 and over the top of this road to Wuling, 105 km and 3,275 m of climbing, has finished here since 2012; its organisers describe the last 10 km as gradients of 17 to 27 per cent. In 2026 the race was moved to a substitute course because of damage on Highway 8 through Taroko.
zh: 全线限速每小时 25 至 40 公里。翠峰以上路窄坡陡，昆阳、武岭、32.9 公里游客中心及小风口设有监视摄影机。台湾 KOM 自行车登山王挑战自花莲海边沿台 8 线上行，再经本线抵达武岭，全长 105 公里、爬升 3,275 米，自 2012 年起以此为终点；主办单位称最后 10 公里坡度达 17% 至 27%。2026 年因太鲁阁段台 8 线灾损，赛事改走备用路线。

why.en: No separate cost for the Wushe supply line has been found. It was built as part of the Central Cross-Island Highway, whose total the directorate's Fourth District anniversary book gives as over NT$430 million in money of the day; the Central Cross-Island dossier gives NT$494.56 million from another source.
why.zh: 未查到雾社供应线的单独造价。它是中横公路工程的一部分；公路总局第四区养护工程处周年纪念专刊称中横公路总工程费 4.3 亿余元（当年币值），本图集中横公路条目则依另一来源记为 4.9456 亿元。

why.en: Funded with the Central Cross-Island Highway, which drew on United States aid; no breakdown for this branch has been found.
why.zh: 随中横公路工程出资，中横公路曾动用美援；未查到本支线的出资分配。

value.zh: 武岭，海拔 3,275 米，约 31.5 公里处；称南岭时测得 3,284 米

figures.source: As cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 武嶺; Taiwan KOM Challenge 2026 race notice, Taiwan Cyclist Federation

timeline.en: The governor-general's army crosses the pass in the Truku campaign; it is named the Sakuma saddle.
timeline.zh: 太鲁阁战役中总督率军越过垭口，垭口因而称为佐久间鞍部。

timeline.en: The Japanese Hehuan crossing road is finished.
Work begins on the Wushe supply line (21 January or 9 June, by different sources).
timeline.zh: 雾社供应线动工（各来源记为 1 月 21 日或 6 月 9 日）。

timeline.en: The supply line opens on 7 May, 42.2 km; the Jieshou pavilion is built at the pass.
timeline.zh: 5 月 7 日，供应线通车，长 42.2 公里；垭口建介寿亭。

timeline.en: Retired servicemen are settled at the former Japanese grazing station, renamed Qingjing farm in 1965.
timeline.zh: 日治见晴牧场开始安置退除役官兵，1965 年改名清境农场。

timeline.en: After the 21 September earthquake closes Highway 8 west of Deji, this becomes the substitute route over the range.
timeline.zh: 9 月 21 日地震使台 8 线德基以西中断，本线成为翻越中央山脉的替代道路。

timeline.en: The Taiwan KOM cycle race, finishing at Wuling, is first held.
timeline.zh: 以武岭为终点的台湾 KOM 自行车登山王挑战首次举办。

timeline.en: The Highway Bureau's snow-season rules bar coaches, lorries over 3.5 t and motorcycles in snow.
timeline.zh: 公路局雪季规定，降雪时禁止大客车、3.5 吨以上货车与机车通行。
